## Activity

During June 2021, River Outreach recorded 23 captures. This report summarises the activity completed during the month and identifies the main operational points for follow-up. The recorded capture volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. Any local factors affecting capture completion should continue to be noted through the usual operational processes so that the service record remains clear and supports ongoing monitoring.

## Image quality

Of the captures submitted, 4 were assessed as ungradable. This represents 17.4 per cent of captures. The recurring camera issues identified by the clinic lead should be logged with the service desk. Recording each issue through that route will support appropriate review and help maintain a clear record of equipment-related concerns. Image quality should continue to be monitored alongside routine capture activity.

## Grading

A total of 0 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. These results should be considered with the image-quality information above when reviewing the month’s service operation. Continued monitoring of grading waits and ungradable captures will help identify any change requiring operational attention.
